index.note: Fact sheet and Key Facts label it 'Bloomberg AusBond Composite Index (AUD)'. Investment-grade Australian government, semi-government, supranational and corporate bonds.

mer.note: Management fee as stated in the PDS

yield.note: BlackRock's '12m Trailing Yield' at 15 Oct 2026: income distributions with ex-dates in the past 12 months (8 Oct 2026, 1 Jul 2026, 9 Apr 2026, 7 Jan 2026; 322.25 cents in total) divided by the latest NAV. Fact sheet: 3.18% at 30 Sep 2026. Other BlackRock figures at 16 Oct 2026: running yield 3.66%, weighted average yield to maturity 5.31%.

franking.note: BlackRock's published 'Franking Level of distributed income' for the year ended 30 Jun 2026 is 0%; bonds pay no franked income.

listed.note: First day of trading on the ASX (ASX company listing date). Daily prices start here.

inception.note: Fund inception (first unit creation); listed on the ASX 14 Mar 2012

duration.note: Effective duration in the September 2026 fact sheet (data at 30 Sep 2026; weighted average yield to maturity 5.38%, average maturity 5.83 years). The product page showed modified duration 4.78 years and YTM 5.31% at 16 Oct 2026.
